name: Shiratori Kanae
source:
A second year student, as well as the president of "Dream Village Exploration" club. She is a diligent student, although quite an airhead. She has a cheerful and kind personality, and often helps her friends in need. She is well-known for her beauty and her heterochromia eyes, entranced many people, including [url=/c22190]Tokiya[/url].

Tokiya tries to use Kokkai no Gi on her, but it doesn't work at all and got rejected as a result (through misunderstanding).

[spoiler]It's revealed in the end of Meguri's route that she is the promised 'observer', the existence to confirm that the [url=/c22190]brother[/url] and [url=/c15099]sister[/url]'s reincarnations have finally 'united' and accepted by the people around them.[/spoiler]
